review_basis: Four-position byte-bound contact-sheet review of all 20 selected clips plus a second review of the first replacement set. Only the remaining rejected scene is changed; the other nineteen selections remain unchanged.

overrides.reason: The previous biology-laboratory imagery falsely implied medical research during narration about frontier AI laboratories.
overrides.semantic_rationale: Developers jointly examining software gives the opening a credible human frontier-technology context without suggesting that the stock footage depicts a named AI laboratory.

overrides.reason: The previous clip displayed a literal password-decryption interface and read as a hacker cliché rather than a controlled model evaluation.
overrides.semantic_rationale: Two developers deliberately reviewing software on a shared screen represents a controlled evaluation process while the official research remains the factual evidence.

overrides.reason: The first replacement showed a cramped cable tangle with an unintentionally comic, low-budget tone; it did not meet the premium cinematic standard even though the network context was technically relevant.
overrides.semantic_rationale: A serious network-operations image should provide a physical analogue for machine-scale technical activity and limited human intervention while the attributed provider report carries every factual claim.

overrides.reason: The previous static restricted-door shot lacked enough motion and visual development for a premium eight-to-ten-second sequence.
overrides.semantic_rationale: A person actively using a controlled-access keypad makes centralized permission, monitoring and revocation visible without presenting the location as a specific AI company.
